description: What a card shows beyond its request; ApprovalFlow's `approval` returns it.

announcement.description: Speak status changes politely, or leave announcements to the host.

expired.description: The host's word that the request lapsed. A decision in flight is aborted.

expiryLabel.description: The host's expiry text. The card runs no clock of its own.

impact.type: readonly { id: string; label: ReactNode; value?: ReactNode; note?: ReactNode; }[] | undefined
impact.description: Who or what the action affects, with amounts, as a compact table.

irreversible.description: True shows the default note in the attention color; a node replaces it.

receiptTime.description: Host-formatted time after the approved receipt, such as «قبل دقيقة».

reversible.description: Lets Ctrl or Cmd+Enter approve, unless the request is also irreversible.

secondaryAction.description: An optional middle action, such as viewing the messages.
